create_positive_map: create a positive map tensor linking object detection boxes to token positions in a tokenizer output
convert_od_to_grounding_simple: convert object detection labels to grounding format with positive maps and generated captions
convert_grounding_to_od_logits_batched: convert grounding logits to object detection logits using scatter_mean for batched token aggregation
sample_classes: sample a subset of classes from a dataset balancing positive and negative classes up to a maximum
get_positive_tokens: find character positions of tokens within a caption string and return their index ranges
